sentences.text: Gobiosuchus was a small, gracile animal featuring long, slender limbs and a relatively elongated neck.
The creature possessed heavy armor consisting of overlapping cylindrical rings of dermal scutes around the neck, torso, and tail, with eight transverse rows on the neck and ten on the torso.
Thickened ridges on the posterior end of the cervical and thoracic scutes limited the animal's flexibility despite its elongated body proportions.
The palate contained pits for sharp, conical teeth, with the largest pit accommodating an enlarged fourth dentary tooth.
The type species Gobiosuchus kielanae is classified within the family Gobiosuchidae.
Gobiosuchus kielanae forms the family Gobiosuchidae together with Zaraasuchus shepardi.
Gobiosuchus lived during the Early Campanian stage of the Late Cretaceous in the Bayn Dzak locality of the Djadochta Formation in the Gobi Desert of Mongolia.
The time range for Gobiosuchus is the Campanian stage, spanning from 83.6 to 72.2 million years ago.
